key_features: Smart Display : Real-time updates on battery percentages and full recharge times.
Built-in Stand : Hands-free viewing while charging.
Advanced Wireless Charging Innovation : Consistent 15W charging with exceptional heat dissipation.
Bi-Directional USB-C Charging : 27W fast charging for both your device and the power bank.
ActiveShield Safety System : Monitors temperature over 3 million times daily for safe charging.
MagSafe Compatibility : Ultra-fast 15W power delivery for MagSafe-compatible iPhones, even with magnetic cases.
